plan.title: Recreate RFQ with Evaluation Duration Cleared

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the two bids described by the case.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order popup.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order popup, verify Product Sheet, Auction Configurations, Delivery Date and Schedule this event are shown; click Clear under Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop on the newly created event or its schedule screen showing that no evaluation window is configured.

steps.note: Perform the popup-only actions and create the replacement order, including clearing Evaluation Duration.
Check that the resulting screen does not show an evaluation-time window.
